paragraphs.title: The Fast and the Appeal for Divine Protection

easy.explanation: Ezra proclaimed a fast beside the river.

answers: A right way for the journey
easy.explanation: They sought a right way for themselves, their little ones, and their substance.
easy.q: What did they seek from God?

easy.explanation: The text says that God was intreated of them.
easy.q: What happened after they fasted and prayed?

answers: He had declared that God’s hand was upon those who sought him
The king was no longer in Babylon
They had no possessions to protect
medium.explanation: Ezra had told the king that God’s hand was upon those who sought him for good.
medium.q: Why was Ezra ashamed to ask the king for soldiers and horsemen?

medium.explanation: He said God’s hand was upon all who sought him.
medium.q: Upon whom did Ezra say God’s hand was for good?

answers: A road to the king’s palace
medium.explanation: It refers to a proper, protected way for the journey.
